notablePrerequisites:
Wight of the Reliquary does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one additional creature.
description:
Activate Wight of the Reliquary by tapping it and sacrificing another creature, causing you to search your library for a land card and put it onto the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters the battlefield, each Scute Swarm you control triggers.
Resolve the first trigger, creating either a 1/1 Insect creature token or a token copy of Scute Swarm.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat from step 3 for each remaining trigger, if applicable.
Repeat from step 1.
